t: Do you remember what you have to do? If you change your mind, tell me, and I will bring you back to the Coliseum.

When you’re standing next to a ball, use “Catch the ball” ability to... catch the ball!

Try and catch this blue one above us.

Mount the Pegasus and use “Wing Swing” ability. You’ll see what happens next...

Get into the air and fly three times through any rings above us.

When there’s a ring in front of you, use “Throw the ball” ability and try to be precise!

Now get into the air and try to throw two balls into the ring above us.

Well, you’re not hopeless. Go back to Dionysius and tell him you’re ready.

If you have any questions, shoot away!
What do you want to hear again?
I will teach you how to fly Pegasi! Whether you want it or not.
Well, let’s start the real trial! I’m teleporting you to the start on the tower top. Grab your Pegasus and fly!

That’s true. Thalos is a formidable enemy. I have something that once belonged to Kyros.

Here.

Before you is the Whirlpool of Time – a special portal that sends you to the void where I temporarily exiled Thalos. There you can fight him without putting our world at risk.

Hurry up! There is little time. My charms won’t last long.

Well... you too. Let me introduce myself - Dakkar de Desirae, the prince of the House. This is my beloved wife, Svetlana Valir.

Are you going to participate in the Games? Good to hear that! We should encourage the wonderful endeavors of this young race.

Great Astral! I barely recognized you! Back in that terrible castle you looked much less... intimidating. I wish I could listen to the stories of your adventures! All I hear recently is the news from my rivals from other Houses. The Great Ball is coming, you know. Things aren’t going that smooth in the elven community...

But let’s not talk about that!

Are you going to participate in the Games? Good to hear that! We should encourage the wonderful endeavors of this young race.

Are you from the Empire? Well, I don’t care! Mark my word - if you keep fighting because of those silly patches on your shoulders, you’ll bring yourself to your doom.

Take Kanians and Xadaganians! They’re all human. They’re absolutely the same! And what are they fighting over? Something that happened even before the Cataclysm? Bah! Idiots.

Well, have a good day, anyway.

Remember how I told you we were going to turn the New Land into a garden city? Froddy sticks to his word, huh. With Nordrak’s help, our sorcerers are driving the cold Astral streams away from the allod, and the glaciers are finally starting to melt!

The plants are following the call of the Great Tree! The grass is starting to grow, and in a couple of years this place will be all green, mark my word!

Extreme fertility!

Look at this! As soon as you drop a seed on the ground, it shoots up into the sky in a blink of an eye!

We need Ammer soil in the New Land!

That’s right. I must say these lands are much prettier that those under the gray skies of Xadagan.

I remember how they called me the Arisen-Who-Lived. I’ve had so many other names since then...

The world changes, and only one thing stays the same - idiots are fighting idiots. There’s no secret that I put my hopes on the Aoidoi.

They are way too pure and naive for war. They can put an end to this! We all should finally learn the lessons of the past.
And I remember you, too. I can’t say those are pleasant memories.
Nefer Ur looks at you, waiting for something.

Everything is so pink and shiny. The ladies are pretty, huh.

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m in the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

It must be nice to live without war. Maybe we can teach the younger generation to be friendlier...

Because if we don’t, we all just might die out one day, haha!

Oh, I know you. You’re the hero of Dane!

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m from the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

Well, I should have guessed. Even the brightest of minds can’t take a stand against the masses. Dust fighting dust, year after year, century after century. Fate has given them common enemies, but they still can’t forget their strife. It’s a shame. But this is how our primitive society works.

Except our next enemy can just wipe us all off the face of Sarnaut.

Nihaz is coming.

What are you going to do?

Your deeds may be great but they led the people of Sarnaut to thinking that if you had defeated Nihaz once, you can do this again. Ha!

But there was no first time. The Dark God was running away from boredom, not from death. And the death of his old friend has drawn his attention to your world again... It’s a shame nobody listens to Klavdia. Her connection with Sarnaut is deeper than anyone else’s.
My people call me the Dominus of Creation. May it be so.

Of course, I'm happy to help! There have been many flights, both from here and from the House de Delice's residence, but I can say for sure that no one suspicious has left the port. It's where Tassilon de Ardeur works!
Absolutely not. There have been no flights from here. And I can assure you that no one suspicious has left Irene from the House de Delice's residence. It's where Josephine de Ardeur works.
Let's see... I'll get it done.
I guess I must be honest. There have been no strange flights from here, and I can say the same about the House de Blizare's residence where Sherman de Ardeur works.
I see. I'll get it done. No problem.

No. You can trust me: just some regular boring flights – to brothels and residences. I know for sure that there have been no strange flights from the House de Blizare's residence where Sherman de Ardeur works.
Of course not, I would've reported it at once! There have been no special flights from here! But there were some from the House de Delice's residence...
Yes, yes. I expected something like this...

Hm... Since the king sent you... I can tell you there have been strange flights both from here and from the pier in the northern districts where Tilbert de Ardeur works. But that's all I can tell you!
Hmm... Yes, everything is in order. I'll get it done.

We have... discussed it with Louis.

Here, a royal decree that orders the closing of all ports on Irene. You will need to inform all the gondoliers of this.

But anyone could run an errand like this, not just the Hero of Sarnaut. Think of it as an extra precaution and a smokescreen. I’m almost certain the general has already left Irene, along with the artifact, and he’s being hunted as we speak.  You’ll have to speak with all the gondoliers and find out if anyone suspicious used their services, and if they did, ask where they went.

Some of them will probably lie. You can be sure that Panto near the palace and Tilbert in the northern districts will tell you the truth, but I’m not so sure about the others.

Hear them all out, and then use your brains to analyze their words and identify contradictions.

Return to Louis once you figure everything out.

He should have secretly left Irene. Since Renard knows everything, we have two options.

First: the artifact is still here. In that case, we need to close all ports on Irene, so we can quietly find out where it is.

Second option: my general managed to leave Irene. Then he probably has people after him, and you will have to chase them all down.
Yes, I see... One of them definitely helped the person we are looking for. Did you find out who it was?

Excellent. In the meantime, Blanche and her intelligence service combed through Irene. By the looks of things, neither the artifact nor the general is here, and they haven’t been for a while. And someone is trying to conceal this fact.

What did you learn from the gondoliers?
No, I’m certain they are trying to divert our attention. I’ll need to think...
That’s strange, she doesn’t seem suspicious. We should look more carefully at the gondolier’s statements.
I disagree. I believe you are wrong. Nothing indicates he’s the one.
Hmm, no. He wouldn’t lie to us. I trust him.

Right! Everything points to him! According to Panto and Tilbert, who wouldn’t lie, and Josephine was also telling the truth. In that case, if what Josephine said was true, then it was Sherman who lied. And if he lied, then someone did leave the port... We need to question him immediately.
Yes, her words are suspicious, but I think she’s just trying to confuse us. We need to keep looking...

You can't handle Tassilon alone, and you'll probably need help again in the future. We'll give you a magic scroll that will allow you to summon our best servants. You have already met them: Ivok, the smartest Aviak, and Potis, the strongest of them.

With their help, you can overcome his resistance. Just visit him with these two and put pressure on him: order Potis to intimidate him, and once it's working, let Ivok reassure him. This should wear him down quickly. And your silence will be the thing that will scare him most! Can you handle it?
That's what We like about you! Here's the scroll. Hurry! Once you learn everything, don't waste time reporting back to me. Go to Blanche right away.

What?! And you came to me with this? Instead of setting out at once...?! That was the right thing to do! Haste without a plan makes waste.

Now listen carefully. The bad news is we don't know where the general is going exactly. And there's no time to find that out.

The good news is we know the local teleportation master, Sarang Ashturi. She has spent years on Ferris – she should know a little about everything that takes place there.

The second good news is Ivok's perception and Potis's eyesight. Ferris's landscapes are too... Vast for you to be able to find any traces on your own. So if you find out where the general was headed, listen to them.

Is your task clear?
Then don't dawdle. We'll ensure you'll have no problems with the portals.

Ooh, adventures... I wish I could go on one!

You must be talking about the Xadaganian general that decided to mount an expedition to the icy place, and about the crazy Lamia queen that's looking for him? Why are you staring? As though anything ever happens here...

I don't know much, but I'll tell you what I know. I heard this general wanted to make camp somewhere near the Frozen Lake, the one in the center of the Bone Valley. I'll mark it on your map.

You should hurry. The vipers looked angry... Once you deal with all that, come back and tell me everything, alright?

I needed it because we were going to the Dragon Bay. The skeleton of one of the Great Dragons is buried there, along with the never-dying heart, the source of dragon blood. The Bond is the artifact used by the Great Mages of elves to bind dragons and collect their blood... It's quite a useful thing...

The Empire needs new Great Mages, so a new source of this blood would come in handy.

And Ferris is the Empire's territory. As an Imperial citizen, you might agree with me...

I needed it because we were going to the Dragon Bay. The skeleton of one of the Great Dragons is buried there, along with the never-dying heart, the source of dragon blood. The Bond is the artifact used by the Great Mages of elves to bind dragons and collect their blood... It's quite a useful thing...

The Empire needs new Great Mages, so a new source of this blood would come in handy.

I know the League sent an expedition to Ferris, too, but it's the Empire's territory! Any speculation about it being a part of ancient Isa is irrelevant.

Love knows no bounds!

Lucretia is a delicate flower among all the weeds. Intrigues weigh heavily on her, and she longs for adventures. I got her attention with stories of my feats, and she showed me a lot... in the art of love.

At any rate, I didn't betray my homeland. Everything I do serves a purpose. I want there to be peace between the League and Empire. The Empire really needs peace right now.

Love knows no bounds!

Lucretia is a delicate flower among all the weeds. Intrigues weigh heavily on her, and she longs for adventures. I got her attention with stories of my feats, and she showed me a lot... in the art of love.

I heard many Leaguers are tired of the war... And I personally know those who became close with someone they had only seen through the eye-slit of their visor before. So it shouldn't surprise you.
What a beast! It's a miracle we escaped.
Oh Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan... Everything hurts...!

I'm glad to hear that! I told you Eurial is capable of anything! She is a viper waiting for an opportunity to strike while everyone falls for her innocent act! A "lovely creature", a "living embodiment of the ideals of the elven race", a "goddess of beauty"... If only you knew how they praise this upstart! She's hiding something, some dark mystery of her origins, I'm sure of it!

Oh, my poor George... I hope I'll see him again soon.
Only our trusted patrons who have the key.
No, guests are not allowed here. The mistress's personal chambers.
Of course! Just use your key!
Hmm... Why do you need to know? I don't like weirdos...
Ah, that's wise! You can go anywhere, there are no secrets. Just stay away from the door guarded by the lamia - it's a private zone, only for the best customers, like me...
Only those who are dressed in a certain way and have a key! What are you bothering me with this? Bring me something to drink...
Ahhh! You're not the only one... Now go... Bring me some wine...
I see you're off your rocker! Go away... And come back with wine...
What now? I don't carry it on me – because of people like you...
Wow! What is this, a role-playing gag?
I like tricks! I won't give you my clothes, of course, but I left another set in my secret stash at the top of the main building – a spare one in case I fall in the water or something, haha!
You need a couturier, it's not something I do!
The edge of the allod! Why? Are you spying on us?
So boring... Just standing next to you makes me feel drowsy.
Aah, I knew it, haha! Go wherever you want, just avoid that door guarded by the lamia. It's a special place...
It's for trusted people, like me! You can't get in without a special outfit and a key!
I can't imagine why you'd want it! But maybe I could use your help with that...
I went on a bender a while ago, must have dropped it somewhere... Could you look around, please?
Yes? I did lose mine, but... Hm... I found another one... Listen, throw this one away, and forget all about it!
Hmm... While I understand why you might need that, I can't help you. Sorry.
Trouble... Life without trouble is boring!
I know what you mean! I understand... There is a special place – the door guarded by the lamia, but I doubt they will let you in...
You need to be dressed a certain way – it's what Eurial's trusted people wear. Like me, for example.
Oh, well. Maybe? I don't know. I found one just recently, but... Why do you need it?
Sorry, but this is not some game!
How sweet! For love, I'll pretend I've lost my key – it won't be the first time!
How would I know? I haven't been there. But the place is packed right now, so with your talents you'll be able to get lost in the crowd. You'll figure out the rest.

I have a very important meeting, and there will be attempts to disrupt it even here, so this disguise is not enough. I asked you for help, because your company won't draw attention, and if things go south, you can protect me. And also because you won't ask too many questions. So, are we going? We don’t have much time.

This shard is called Secluded Sanctuary. The name fits. People rarely come here – only when they seek solitude. It's a great place for secret royal meetings, if you disregard the complete lack of guards.

They say special magic dwells here – whatever the cause, no one has found an explanation for the local lake's infinite supply of water which flows to the beautiful canals in the city and the river in our forest.
I'll tell you after the meeting.

I need you to do something for me outside the palace grounds. It would be too suspicious if we left together, so we'll meet there.

Among the shards of Irene, there's one you have probably never visited before, and the gondoliers won't offer to take you there. You'll go to the gondola near the palace and ask the gondolier to take you to the Secluded Sanctuary.

Constance and I... we'll find our own way there and wait for you on the pier.

Truly? This is where our interests cross... But my mission is not that secret. I'm looking for my sister. I have reasons to believe there's a connection between her and Eurial. You have probably found something inside – give it to us, and you can leave.
There will be no "later"! You do realize you either hand it to us, or we'll... take it, right?

I didn't want to alarm the queen, but I think someone was watching us from the windows of the next building... I hope I'm wrong, but we need to be careful. I don't think her date... Oh, I mean meeting, will take much time.
Turning uncouth heroes into dignified young people! We, the House de Grandeur, will do everything in our power to make sure you do not embarrass yourselves at the royal reception.

No specific instructions – you have to feel it in your heart! To make it less complicated, I will approve of your correct behavior and disapprove of bad one. Know that I assess your every move, and the more elegant gestures you use to express yourself, the better!

But all in all... Enjoy your evening! Try some wine or engage someone in conversation.

Just don't speak with Solemna de Ardeur – you won't hear anything good from her, that's for sure.

You heroes never do anything for free! What about invaluable social skills?

...Fine, of course we reward those who make an effort. I'll be watching you, and you can come get your reward at any time. But remember: the greater the effort, the better the reward!

You can get your reward either during the lesson by talking to me, or we'll reward you afterwards along with everyone else.
Join us! A lesson is in progress!
But don't stray too far, the next lesson begins soon! We'll just clean up a little...
That's it...? Well, I'll find some kind of consolation reward for you, but you might want to stay a bit longer and earn something worthwhile...
You did quite well! Are you sure you want to take your reward now? I think you can do even better...
That's too bad... Here's your well-deserved reward!
I'll be happy to reward you with our best prize! Please don't leave us before the lesson ends – show other heroes a proper way to conduct oneself!
The audacity! Get out before I report your "performance" to the guard!
You already got your reward, don't try and trick me! If you want another, wait until the next lesson!

That farce of the House de Grandeur and their attempts to teach something they don't know themselves. Arranging "free lessons" to "teach others manners"!

Maybe you could help me... liven up this event? Break a glass or something...

Just don't do what they ask you to do and show them what impropriety means. Smash glasses, dance on the table – let yourself be free.

They didn't let me organize the tenth anniversary, Catherina handled everything! Now I'll show them what a good party looks like!

I'll back you up so no one will throw you out early. Just make sure to give it your everything.

What about the fun you'll have in the process?!

Fine, I have gifts you'll appreciate. The bigger the mess you make, the happier I'll be!

You can get your reward either during the lesson by talking to me, or we'll reward you afterwards along with everyone else.
What, you don't like this farce either? We are alike, you and I...
Stay close – it's going to start soon, and I'll find a fun activity for you...
You have already received it. Help me next time – you'll get more!
Pfft, that was pitiful. I expected more from you. I'll find something to give you, but are you sure you don't want to stay longer?
That was fun! Are you sure you've had enough? I'll give you your reward, of course, but I think there's potential for something better here.
Oh... Well then, come back soon!
Hahaha! You should've seen her face! I didn't know heroes could do that!
Hahaha... Huh? What? Yes, here it is. Thanks.
Pfft, you? For what? For following Cecilia's orders? Go see her, then.
A true social event! Don't waste your time – enter and prove yourself, and if you need something, speak with Cecilia de Grandeur, she's in charge of this event.
We ask you to take part in this noble endeavor – it's in full swing!
Soon a social event will take place here! I suggest you speak with Cecilia de Grandeur - she is in charge of this event.
Oh, ! Don't stray too far, our lesson is starting soon!
Fun under the guise of decorum! Come in and speak with Solemna de Ardeur, or jump in and enjoy yourself! Don't let snobbish comments discourage you!
What are you waiting for?! Come in before you miss it!
Here we are holding a rather unusual event: under the guise of decorum, we learn to be ourselves and have fun! Speak with Solemna de Ardeur – she should be somewhere on the podium.
Next lesson will begin soon! Don't miss it!
Ugh... I can't run anymore... If you want to beat me up, do it. Just don't make me run...
Oh, , it's you! Sorry, I didn't recognize you. With my lifestyle, it's usually safer to run away... Why are you here?
Of course I'm fine, didn't you see me running?! The Hero of Sarnaut could barely keep up! As for my responsibilities... Yes, I got carried away, perhaps. I'll get back to work... Tonight, I think.
To what do I owe the pleasure...?

Oh, ! I've heard about your skills.

You wish to challenge me? Go ahead!

If they say so, then I am.

Let me guess... You want to challenge me, too?

That's quite... ambitious of you.

But if I fight everyone who wants to challenge me for the title, I'll have no time for my personal life. First prove you are really worth my time.

Well, let's say... Win a hundred duels on Irene.

But pick strong opponents, not weaklings, or else you won't learn anything. You don't think defeating me will be easy, do you?

Once you have honed your skills, find me. I'll give you a fight.

Ciao!

Oh, that's too bad!

Do you want to play another character?

We have three roles in our play: King Grallon, his daughter Princess Daguta, and the mysterious Traveler whose name is unknown. You can choose any of the roles. Talk to me when you do. Hurry, because someone else may pick the role.

Our audience experiences a range of emotions during the performance. We must ensure that the play elicits all sorts of emotions from them. So a good actor watches the audience, trying to engage them with their acting. Give them a full spectrum of emotions – and they will be elated!

Perhaps we won't find enough actors for the play... But that's alright! My assistants will fill in the rest of the roles. Of course, it's better when characters are played by people who understand each other, so if you have friends who might be interested – invite them here.
Oh, it's very simple. I'll tell you when the time comes. For now, just enjoy the performance of others.

Oh, it's a famous story closely tied to Irene!

The last elven kingdom used to be here. During the Cataclysm, it survived only thanks to a mysterious artifact that King Grallon kept close – the Key of Creation. The king had a daughter, young Princess Daguta who was trying to get herself a husband.

Everything was fine until a mysterious Stranger showed up at the gates, guided by his own ambitions and desires! He seduced Daguta, compelled her to steal the Key, and thus doomed them all!

King Grallon escaped with a handful of courtiers, and they watched Irene sink into the Astral. But as we know now, the allod wasn't completely destroyed \...

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

What role would you like to play?

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Oh no, don't answer! I can already see you on the stage of my Theatre! When the time comes...
I have a role for you in the next act. You just need to wait for it to start!

You look gorgeous as this character!

Now act!

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Speak with me before the next act begins, and I will let you pick a role!

Splendid, the role of King Grallon is yours!

The play starts in a few minutes. Or as soon as we find actors for all the roles. Perhaps you know something who could be a good fit? Then call them!

Splendid, the role of the Traveler is yours!

The play starts in a few minutes. Or as soon as we find actors for all the roles. Perhaps you know something who could be a good fit? Then call them!

Splendid, the role of Princess Daguta is yours!

The play starts in a few minutes. Or as soon as we find actors for all the roles. Perhaps you know something who could be a good fit? Then call them!
Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus! Do you have any questions?
Talk to other patrons, rest, dance, try cocktails and hookahs, swim in the pool. There are also individual pavilions if you'd like to get away from the noise.

Sounds great!

Now let's find you an outfit.

Wonderful! You look quite alluring.

The door of our garden is open for you. Step inside and find Beauty and Pleasure.

Enjoy your stay!

Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures!

Before you dive into the sea of pleasures, you will need a proper name and outfit.
You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures.
Isn't it obvious? I'm the head of Irene intelligence and its only representative you will meet.
What's wrong, Guest of Irene? Are you bored?
Would the Guest like to play a part in a play?
Does the Guest like to wear masks?
Does the Guest wish to play spy games? Interesting!
One of us. Great. I have a job for you.
Does the Guest wish to play spy games? Interesting!
One of us. Great. I have a job for you.

Oh Tep, the people I have to work with... We always meet with our informers somewhere we won't draw attention: in a theatre, in a square in the northern district, in the garden near the palace, in the middle of the main street, near a brothel, or at the lake at the Secluded Sanctuary. If you forget this again...
Is this your first time? I think I've seen you before... Hmm. You'll recognize them easily - by their carnival mask. Or should I also tell you what an informer does?
He will be waiting for you SOMEWHERE HIGH WHERE VOICES CANNOT BE HEARD.
He will be waiting for you WHERE THE STONE GUARDS ARE SLEEPING.
He will be waiting for you WHERE YOU CAN HEAR THE APPLAUSE.
He will be waiting for you IN THE GOLDEN GARDEN AT THE KEY POINT.
He will be waiting for you NEAR IMMORAL BEAUTY.
He will be waiting for you BETWEEN THE DWELLING OF SHIPS AND THE HOUSE OF FOOLS.

Find our informer. He'll give you the information and tell you who it's meant for. But be careful: sometimes Irene intelligence replaces our informers with their agents, and if they catch you, they'll know you're one of us. Remember: our informers never carry a weapon.

But if you were, say, a double agent, you could still tell them everything and get what you need... What was I talking about?
First time? Alright, I'll give you a hint – just change all letters to the next one in the alphabet.
, is that you? Oh Tep, another minute and there'll be clash of blades... I'm also an undercover agent. What do you want?
Great. Here's the package, it's all there. I wrote the info on the liaison's whereabouts and appearance on the package. It will be gibberish for anyone else, but you'll figure it out...
What?! You... Here, take it, I don't want any problems! I won't tell anyone! It's all written on the package – the place and the person who should get it!
Ugh, I almost... Alright, colleague. What do you want from me?
A part of your mission, right? I have the package Take it... And good luck.
Is this some kind of joke?
How about that. You have the information?
How do you like the weather?
Ugh, I thought you weren't coming. Give me the package.
Where were you? Do you have it?
Great, you took your time. Good work. You have the information?
Yay, we won't be killed today. Do you have it?
Oh, I was just starting to enjoy the wait. Give it here.
Great. Instructions for all agents for the next few days: hunt down the blue raven. Go now.
Great! Instructions for the next day: do not touch the hedgehog's prickles until it falls asleep.
Got it. Directive for the next day: do not jump into the canals unless you have scared the fish away.
Well, well. Good. Instructions for the next day: do not be silent near entrances on the main streets.
Keep that up. Instructions for the next day: take care of the little swallow. You can go now.
Good job, soon you won't have to run errands anymore... Your next instructions: do not give the bear white honey. See you soon.
Very well. This is the instruction: drink water from the lake where hedgehogs swim.
Yep. New instructions for all agents: dance under the moon near the blue canals.
How about that. Your next instructions: watch the lovely sunrise after buying wine.
Good job! Instructions for the next day: tame the deer that want to eat grass!
Everyone is here... New instructions for all agents: sit on the stump until the blackbird returns to the nest!
That’s good. Your new instructions: march where everyone can see you so the cats run away!
Great, you took your time. Good work. You have the information?
Intelligence reports that our current password is TERIONTADOH.
Intelligence reports that our current password is MIASTRINIT.
Intelligence reports that our current password is MIASTRAINIT.
Intelligence reports that our current password is MIRASTINIT.
Intelligence reports that our current password is TERINOTADOH.
Intelligence reports that our current password is TORIENTADOH.
Intelligence reports that our current password is PERISKIAL.
Intelligence reports that our current password is PERIASKAL.
Intelligence reports that our current password is PESKIRIAL.
Intelligence reports that our current password is SHERKUILOAN.
Intelligence reports that our current password is SHEKURIOLAN.
Intelligence reports that our current password is SHELIKURION.
He should be at the harbor now.
You can find him in the palace square.
He should be in the Hornbeam Alley now.

Finally someone good! We don't have much time, and we're running out of whatever's left. You must act as a carrier agent. Receive your assignment from the puppeteer agent and get in touch with their liaison. We have grounds to believe that he's the one that distributes the instructions among other working agent for the next 24 hours. Find out what the instruction is and return to me. They've got a lot of gophers. They'll hardly take any notice of you. Most importantly, you must follow the whole chain step by step from the controlling agent to the liaison without raising suspicion. Act quickly. If you take too long, you'll have to start over.

What do you want to know?

I'm mostly resting. I also make sure every racer can safely finish the race and return to the city. As you can see, it's hard to get out of here on your own... Though why would you? It's such a nice forest...

If only you knew how many people I interact with daily... Though it can get lonely at night, that's true. But I don't mind! They say there'll be another noble entertainment here soon – boar hunting on horseback! With something like that, peace will become a distant dream...

Seriously, where will they get boars...?
I could take a walk around the forest...
I could take a walk around the forest...

I know what you mean. Our House wanted to arrange spectacular races, but reality sometimes plays a mean trick on you. You see, Irene is not well suited for classic races, so we had to think of something else... If only you knew how we fought de Desirae for the right to disturb the peace at the Secluded Sanctuary! We had to build walls to fend them off!

Not to mention the tricky magic that hides our races from inquisitive eyes so no one disturbs our noblemen! As though races are a less dignified activity than drinking wine.

But you know, people seem to like it. So in the end we only have true fans here. I believe I’m... Pleased.

It’s simple: the residence of de Delice, residence of de Blizare, then through the port and the main street, through the park and the square of the Northern districts to the local pier... The task becomes more interesting then: you need to find a checkpoint in all three parts of the forest in turn: northern, eastern, and southern.

Everyone picks their own route. The only condition is you need to go through all checkpoints in the correct order and reach the finish line!
We haven’t seen you at our races in a while!
Just choose your transport, and if there are free spots in the upcoming race, you’ll be teleported to the start!

The first one who wishes to start a race picks their transport and begins preparations. The preparation lasts 1 minute, and that is when other participants can join. One race can have up to 10 participants.

The race starts once the minute is over. Your goal is to cross the checkpoints in order as fast as you can. The next checkpoint becomes visible once you cross the previous one, so you won’t be able to fool our magic!

To be faster than anyone else, use the abilities of your transport and plan your route carefully!

At first we wanted to reward the racers for the top places, but it turned out such competition provokes... Varying responses, so to speak.

So instead you can beat the records for this route and get medals as a reward, along with an honorary title!

It’s the Hares! They are incredibly fast and blend well into the landscape of Irene. And thanks to our magic, they can jump even when they are already in the air...! Though they would need a break after three such jumps.

The dance starts here in the Ballroom every 15 minutes.

To participate, you need a dance partner. Many people gather in the hall before the dance. Among them are the elves of great houses and guests from other lands, like you. Invite someone.

Then wait until I give the signal.

If this is your first time here, don't worry. We made sure even inexperienced dancers can perform the Ice Dance. The guiding aura will show you where to go, and I will tell you which pirouettes you need to perform during the dance. The better your dancing, the higher His Majesty will rate your talent, and the more ecu you will earn.

It might be difficult at first, but you will master it after a few dances. If you still feel unsure, talk to me before the dancing starts. I will enchant your skates, and they will move around the room on their own - you will only need to perform pirouettes.

The hardest thing for a beginner is to keep up with the guiding aura. I can enchant your skates so they follow it automatically. All you have to do is perform pirouettes at the right moment.

Of course, I will only rate your Grace as you perform pirouettes, and your reward will be lower than what you can earn if you follow the guiding aura properly.

If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

Well?

Done!

Now take your place in the Guiding Aura. As soon as the dancing starts, the skates will move on their own!

If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

Done!

I believe in you: you will be able to perform the Ice Dance without any help in no time.

The ballroom is the largest room in the Galleon. Dancing requires a lot of space!

This year, thanks to a wonderful gift from the House de Blizare, we were able to organize a special event for our guests, the Great Ice Dance that I personally helped put together!

You absolutely must take part in it.

Oh, that mask! It's a true miracle! Its magic allows you to turn into a bird and fly! The enchantment is not perfect, however, so the transformation is temporary. But a fairy's aura can replenish the mask's magic...
How, you ask? You will have to find that out once you take to the air.

You can purchase the mask from me, but it will only start working once you have gained a friendly reputation with the House de Pluie.

Although, if you don't have the mask yet, I can lend you one for this task.
Here! And watch the timer: if the enchantment runs out, and you are still in the air... Poof! You fly straight into the Astral.
A good hunt is great both for the body and mind!

Noblemen are hunting noble beasts! Well, almost...

Our House decided to create a more accessible version of an ancient form of entertainment - horseback hunting!

Except we have deer instead of horses and enchanted Irene Hedgehogs instead of game. That's should make it easier and more exciting!

There's nothing tricky about it: just mount a deer and try to catch a hedgehog with a magic net, and if you get bored, you can become a hedgehog yourself!

You can pick a role and tell me about it: magic will take care of the rest.

If you want to join as a hunter, we will give you an Irene Deer and a magic net. Your objective is to catch as many enchanted hedgehogs with it as you can! You can catch any number of them - the hedgehogs enjoy this activity!

If you want to become prey, we will cast a spell on you that will turn you into a hedgehog. Run away from hunters - the longer you stay uncaptured, the more points you will earn! You can run for as long as you want - until you get tired or bored.
You have the honor of representing His Majesty's interests in the lands of Al Rihat. You'll be rewarded, of course.

quests: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Monster Huntress

t:
I have no tasks for you right now.

His Majesty's interests in Al Rihat are represented by ambassadors with proper combat training and certain reputation level with the royal family.

In your case it's just a formality, but all formalities must be observed at the Court.

Come back later.

quests: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Monster Huntress

t: Isn't it legendary? Everything must shine and look awesome! Our luxurious feast's visitor must have everything they wish for. Do you think this happens by itself? No way. There's one man behind it.
My brother and I must sign this? Why would we? Excuse me, but you have yet to prove yourself by serving the magic and our House.

Well, I can sign it. Your deeds speak for themselves. You have proved that the future of magic is safe with you. I have my brother's permission to sign it on his behalf. Dragons are the base of the Great Mages' power. This world wouldn't survive without them. Do you even realize that everything started here, on Irene?

Now you understand that they used to fascinate the elves. It led many to ruin, and some to madness. There's great power in dragon blood. We all use it. Are we worthy of it? This question has yet to be answered.  Here's the signature.
Darling, I'd sign your papers with great pleasure if only you have earned our House's trust. I'm sorry, but it won't happen until you've earned it.

Beauty is a great power. Do we have the right to judge the world by our own values? Did we become someone else when we abandoned Beauty in favor of Pleasure? I often think about it. Look at the Irene Viper through the eyes of the first elves. What do you see?
I'm glad you can appreciate their beauty. You've come a long way. I'll sign your permit.
Hah! Do you want my signature? You know what? I'll sign it. But you have to prove your worth to my House first.

Dragons. My people are infatuated with them. You know the history. We wanted to be like them. Many of us are still drawn to them. And Anastasia, too... I think you both have a similar appreciation for their beauty and grace. I have one of her ballads – it's about a dragon. A dragon who knows his days are numbered. Dragons don't belong in our world. Alas! Is that what you think?
That is true. I'd love to visit the world they came from. Perhaps I will! Who knows? I'm ready to sign your permit.
I'm sorry, buddy, but time is money. I mean, it's only fair if you spend a little of your time helping my House before asking for something, am I right?

Dragons. Hmm. They've been pretty marketable lately. Of course, this happened after my cousin Hugh de Pluie, the Oligarch, discovered the dragon island deep in the astral. Together with his friends, he stole the eggs and hatched tiny dragons. This is how the rare creatures came about. Of course, they're no match for the Great Dragons such as Soliskar or Agrus, not to mention the Dragon Keepers but still, they're dragons, aren't they? They're ruthlessly exploited, but how do you think this will end?

Yes, that's the word on the street. The dragons are gathering an army. They got over the defeat at the Dead City, and now they're preparing to challenge us again. They want to leave Sarnaut. But at what cost? Who knows... Well, alright. Hand me that permit. I'll sign it.

That's right. They wanted to finish what they started. But the other members didn't care for it. By then, dragons had been defeated by the Junes. It made the elves realize that the dragons weren't the immaculate, perfect example. This understanding shaped our today's society. I'm saying all this to make you see how important dragons are. Give me your permit. I'll sign it.
My friend, you've done so little. Unfortunately, I can't trust you.

Dragon blood holds this world's greatest power! The power that allowed us to stop the astral. As an alchemist, I have spent years studying this substance. A long time ago we came to understand that their power... is not of this world. Just like the power of the Great Trees. They have a lot of things in common, but many things are different. Dragon Flame is the ideal eradicator. It destroys even non-combustible things. Great Tree saplings are strong enough to create new matter from the Astral. What do you think?

I agree with you. We have a theory that the entire Universe with all the worlds in it is ruled by these Powers: Creation and Destruction, Life and Death. Two sides of a coin, and neither exists without the other. You understand the nature of things. I'll sign your permit.

Dragons. I've never considered them fascinating. Dragons are monsters! Heroes are supposed to kill monsters. You took down the Fiery Father also known as Sheratan. We elves know other names of dragons. Alsirr, Zuben, Nashira, Rewati, Regul, Rukbat, Sargas, Sirma, Situla, Tegmin, Elnat. Twelve Dragon Keepers. Twelve giants who tormented the world until the Junes dealt with them. Only their children survived and gave birth to all other dragons of this world. They don't really belong to this world. Dragon still hate us all. Do you realize it?

But they can't do it on their own. They need help. The dragons tried to create their own... First Priest... Lickflame Tinderbox. He was the only one that could open the Star Gates with the Key. Neither Soliskar nor Agrus can do it. Now that they're dead, the dragons are trying to create new ones... or find an ally among the Great Mages. Mages whom they deeply hate. However, strange times call for strange alliances. You know what lies ahead. I'll sign your permit.
Always choose the path of the Light, my friend, and perhaps eventually you'll be able to earn my trust.
I knew Renard had a hand in this. It’s outrageous.

Louis wants everyone to get along!

But Renard has gone too far. House de Delice has the right to do what they think is necessary. I admit we shouldn’t have made Iris a mediator between me and Yasker... But we should be able to negotiate freely.

Oh please, me and Yasker have known each other for a while. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

What matters is he’s willing to listen.

I’m glad you understand. I’ve known Yasker a long time. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

But it laid the ground for negotiation. Just don’t tell Rysina. She can’t know about this.

Yes, it was a close call...

…

Listen, about what happened at the residence of that viper... I’m sorry it got to that. But you have to understand - we were worried about Iris’s disappearance, and we had no other leads.
Phew, I’m glad you’re not holding a grudge. I wouldn’t want us to fall out after what happened on Umoir. Besides, I might need your help. Do you think we can win?
Yes... People will be angry. But we shouldn’t blame the vampires. This is a difficult time for them, too. People should know that Annette and the others are fighting Nihaz for our world!
I’m glad you believe in us! We need to win, and people should know that Annette and the others are fighting Nihaz for our world! Maybe we should make a speech in their defense.

No, though I had to spend a while in that monastery on Lumenara... I was afraid that viper would poison me, but the only real threat was boredom. All they do there is pray, read pious books, and sing in a choir...

What else could I do?

After my escape, I still had some connections over there, so I was able to bypass the Committee and contact Yasker’s people directly.

They wouldn’t have caught me if I hadn’t taken an interest in that viper Eurial. She’s clever. Spotted the tail quickly and struck back. I don't know who she is but she’s clearly someone to fear.

Nothing. My spy career is over, so I’ll spend my days like my sisters, in blissful idleness. Though perhaps I’ll join Gala in her diplomatic work, rescuing vampires, werewolves, demons, and other unfortunate souls.

Yes, listen carefully: Eurial is not who she says she is. I know she recently visited both House de Grandeur and House de Vevre. Do you know what they have in common? They both once lived on Grok.

There it is. I’ve learned that soon after the Cataclysm, she went there with her parents. She was a young girl then, but there was already something intimidating about her. No one but the Great Mage Claud de Vevre knew who they were, but the locals gave an accurate description. They lived in his Tower for a while, and then simply vanished.

Since the first truce! That was when we first exchanged our prisoners - the same way it happened on Yazes. George was our prisoner back then... He was wounded and had a long recovery. I often visited him at night... And he told me a lot. Alas, soon he had to leave me.

That’s when I spoke to Antoinette. By then, she had already decided we needed a solid peace.

It’s not strange.

The world we are building will have less wars and more love. All nations will work together, and our unity will help us defeat any enemy that threatens our existence.

I’m afraid there will be no peace then.

Renard wants peace on his own terms, and Yasker is not willing to make significant sacrifices. Which means the war will flare up again.

While the cardinal is confident of his victory, it may be the beginning of the end.
What can she do? She has no House, no family, she’s just a bastard or unwanted child of some nameless performers. I have everything under control.

My dear friend, you’re spending too much time with Imelda de Luner! What connections, what horrible things? It’s nothing uncommon among the Great Houses. She’s probably a lovechild of de Vevre and Grandeur. Or do you think Nihaz has a hand in this, too? Discuss this with Elhe de Doucer. She could use another source of inspiration, and your tales should do splendidly.
As expected, the dirty dancing of our archduchess is no longer a secret. I see you can’t wait to hear everything.
Of course! We’ve been watching her for a while. When I say “we”, I mean the League, of course. Pavel Isaev is very interested in the affairs of the House de Delice! We have finally exposed them.

She was a mediator between her mother and the Empire. Antoinette’s life is in the open, but her disgraced and exiled daughter won’t surprise anyone if she starts hanging around seedy areas, looking for adventures.

Admittedly, we didn’t suspect her right away. Only Eurial managed to bring Iris’s affairs to light.
It’s possible, that’s why I have her watched, too. I can’t trust anyone in this business. Even myself, haha!

Listen... When I saw all these important people, I got scared... Now I’m afraid to go there... And perform? I feel nervous! I can’t breathe!

I believe the band can do without me! I’m sorry.
Anyone can pick up the bugle and play! You just need to blow hard!
There are many Pridens! Ask any of them! Anyone will agree if you ask them!
Any Priden can learn to play the bugle! They teach us when we’re just cubs... So everyone on Howlem knows this tune!
I understand... But I’m afraid I’ll disappoint him, you, and the audience, eysh... I just can’t...
Your words are nice, but they don’t touch my heart, because we are strangers to each other. Your belief in me does not awaken my own belief.

Yes, the First say you need to fight fear... I believe you’re right, eysh. I can’t let my ancestors and my people down. I’ll overcome my fear and go back. But... I’m lost and can’t find Caspar... Will you take me?

I admit I feel like a village bumpkin around here. Our House is famous for its history, but it’s not very wealthy. The opulence here is... astonishing. Although I’m still an uninvited guest they’re doing their best to avoid. They fear me... well, I’ll wait for Gala to make her move.

Of course. I must win! Once I become the ruler of elves, I will change the world. I will make it better. It will be a time of harmony and prosperity, love and welfare... Together we’ll eliminate all threats and do the impossible...

Hello again, . Renard has done well. When he’s not meddling, he can be very efficient. His creations will serve me... If my House wins the Great Game.
I think I’ll commission two more castles from him. Ignis is not as big as I’d like it to be, and I have a large family that needs space.
That was grand! I always dreamed of seeing Renard humiliated, and you managed to destroy all his arguments!
Winning always feels nice! I knew that our efforts would bring us victory in the Great Game sooner or later. Relying on diplomacy was a good idea.

Psst, ! How about some ancient magic?

It’s a great idea - awakening these statues. They used to stand guard over the ancient kingdom, and now they’ll help us win this competition.
Wow, such power! Perhaps these creations are the future. Living creatures will stop waging wars on each other, and statues, golems, and Mechanoids will be fighting in their stead...
I am glad Antoinette has won - after all, she is our ally. I think her reign will be beneficial to all our Houses. Peace will allow us to focus on existing magical problems.
I don’t doubt it! We rehearsed for days. I hope no one gets the jitters before the show.
No one had any doubts about it. My wards gave it their all. I believe we should do it again. Interracial orchestras are the future!

Welcome to the Great Ball, !

Soon the most beautiful thing in existence will fill these halls - music!

I hope everyone is ready?

That was amazing! I knew a band like this will be popular, but I had no idea how much!

What does it prove? That all races can work together and live in peace!
House de Delice deserved to win, we have to admit that. As you can imagine, my vision of Sarnaut's future is concurrent with hers.
Hah, I knew my House could create something incredible. This Castle is magnificent!

I’m glad I was freed... But there was this one gal from the Committee, a really hot thing who enjoyed interrogating me. I didn’t mind at all... ahem... I mean, we had a mutually beneficial arrangement.

Other than that, I guess I should feel grateful...?

I’m glad I was freed... But there was this one gal from the Committee, a really hot thing who enjoyed interrogating me. I didn’t mind at all... ahem... I mean, we had a mutually beneficial arrangement.

It’s too bad the League didn’t free the others sooner. Captivity was really hard for some of us.

I’m a technomancer. Like many others in my House. I combine magic and technology into a single entity. Right now I’m resting, then I’ll work on the commission I received recently. What’s this commission? I’m sorry I can’t tell you right now. But it involves Catherina and the Empire. So I’ll have to go back. This time to Igsh, though, not Suslanger.
I’m a bit nervous, to be honest... Everything is so gorgeous here, but I need to concentrate on my speech... Hmm, maybe I should have a drink, perhaps it will make me more eloquent?
Well, you will make an excellent defender at the trial.
Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit all... inconvenient details.

Yes, thank you for your interest, but I’m not ready to show you my masterpiece. Today I’ll see what the others will offer and perhaps sign a few contracts. Besides, my cousin Hugh should arrive soon. He’s one of the Tycoons, and the loveliest ladies will accompany him... Don’t miss it!
Galleon Castle would be more beautiful if there were more statues. Nude figures carved in cold marble! And more paintings, of course!

To be honest, I was counting on a slightly different outcome! But perhaps we should look on the bright side. Peace contributes to trade, so we will get richer over time. It will help me win next time! Hugh suggests a new idea: we take the imperial Dream Factory, improve it, shoot stories, build mobile "theaters", sell tickets!
I think I’ve seen her. No, I’m sure. She’s here... I can’t believe it...
Yes! I can’t believe they let her in. She even winked at me, the viper! Please be careful. Eat and drink only from the common table... I hope she doesn't poison anyone...
Honestly, I was afraid I wouldn’t see Iris... all these games of the Great Houses are dangerous.
Don’t be hasty, my friend. I’m just a soldier, and my beloved could be a daughter of the future queen of elves. Who knows, who knows...
It’s... lovely here. Renard did a good job.

It’s impressive...

Though I’m afraid our cardinal has lost the advantage of surprise over the last ten years. Galleon Castle would have been astonishing back then. Today it’s familiar... and the Great Ball is meant to shock and amaze.

He is troubled by our reports. At least we don’t have to worry about a war against the Empire. And if Antoinette wins, we should find a way to eliminate the Imperial threat before a new conflict arises. At any rate, our House will support the League...
Oh yes, I believe we came to an understanding... Actually, we’ve been getting along quite well ever since you and I went to that horrid Otherverse. Adventures bring even enemies closer.

It’s more about uniting those who believe in the Light. Pridens, the Tekyan, Aviaks... Many in Sarnaut share our faith, even if it takes different forms.

We’ve reached agreement on some issues... Knowing that the Source of Light is a faith that exists thanks to the God of Darkness Nihaz, we can no longer believe in it the way we used to. We still have a lot of questions: are there other Sources of Light outside Sarnaut? Sarn was the God of Light, but he fell. Are there any others? I suppose our Church’s mission will be finding answers to these questions. There will be many disputes and revelations... But in the end we will find the truth.
Well, it’s quite beautiful here. Renard and Romain have done a good job. I’m impressed. Brother invested so much into this Castle, it would be a shame to lose.

I doubt anything can truly stop time! But slowing it down while you yourself become faster... That’s possible! I used to work on accelerating reactions, but they have a limit... But influencing time itself – that’s a new one...
That’s what I was talking about. Alright, we might not win, but we didn’t lose face. I’ve already received a few orders for a few batches.
Even though I’ve won before, I’m still nervous, . How will it go? I hope there will be no undesirable side effects.
It looks like everything went well, . I’ve made quite an interesting potion, haven’t I? Just imagine the possibilities!
How beautiful and elegant. Absolutely fantastic!

Yes, them. The place was in ruin ten years ago, and it was impossible to get across the chasm. So we needed to think of transportation... It was our House that created these elegant, light, and maneuverable gondolas that connect all city districts.
This is where the history of elves is being made.

The Great Game is underway, and it’s usually the source of anything unusual here. Houses are willing to do a lot to win, as Armando’s example has shown us. Although I have a feeling that this time we’re dealing with some ancient House...
I think we’ve discussed this before. I belong to the House that has been gone for centuries - House de Dernier.
Lower your voice, . Slow down. We’ll talk about this later.
Galleon Castle! It finally works the way it should.

Ahem!

You could say that, though I don’t consider Gorluxor’s creation a proper one. It’s like a... Pirate copy?

Our beautiful castle where you can simply live was turned into some terrible weapon for destroying allods! It’s not what we built it for... Though admittedly the idea appealed to many... Still, I’m against it.

We started the construction of a few more Castles. There will be dozens of them in a decade.
Ugh, I didn’t think I’d ever set foot here again... After everything I’ve done, I never expected to be let in.

Eh, I’d rather not tell that to random strangers, especially those from the Empire. But if you are curious, I’ll give you a hint...

This Galleon Castle is not the first one. Not even a second one. In short, it’s because of me. Or rather, because of love. For one very convincing bastard.

Thankfully, my cousin Romain helped me... Or else it would’ve probably cost me my head!

Yes, he practically saved me!

Even though I had to spend the next few years swabbing decks.

Damned Armando! I hear you killed him three times. That’s too bad. I’d kill him thirty three times, and that still wouldn’t be enough...

You said it. We are both afflicted by gullibility. Me and my sister, Celestine. She, too, believed people who shouldn’t be trusted. It’s terrible...

I think I need a drink. I feel awful...
Hey, it's you, ! I've got a problem, and we need your help.
What would we do without you, ? There's nothing worse than an unfinished job just before a deadline!

Yep. See, I had to leave my small business on Eljune. I'm selling holy water!

You see, there's no saying "no" to the head of my House. It was fun. I didn't have to take care of anything. Just relaxed in the cabin while the money kept coming in. And then there were lovely pilgrims... Remember Lara? Oh...

Anyway, I've always wanted to attend the new Great Ball. I'd be happy to if I didn't need to work!

On behalf of the House de Blizare, I welcome you, ! I'm Maximilien de Blizare, the head of this House and the Great Mage of Gelida allod.

On behalf of the House de Blizare, I'd like to thank you for helping me with my great scientific experiment.
, welcome to the glorious House de Vevre! I'm Caspar de Vevre, head of the House, and the Great Mage of the Florenta allod.

Ugh... Let me catch my breath. I'm tired of running after these sheets. Caspar won't give me a break!

Remember Gipat, ? Remember how you had to figure out who killed me? Should anything happen, blame the head of my House.

Oh, that Gipat... I hear people still gather in the arena to fight. I guess it's their idea of fun.

We grew tired of collecting dragon symbols pretty soon. I, Semyon Gromov, and the Brave Family joined Seaside the Bloodthirsty, Maxim Kulakin, and Yaver Useranat, and organized special battles of our own. Perhaps you took part in them at some point. You know skirmishes? Teams of three or six? It was our idea.

Of course, the Free Traders helped a lot. But we were the pioneers!
Greetings! I'm glad to see you in this lovely place. I'm Orphus. I teach the magic of music to the Aoidoi.
Oh, marvelous fate, ! I'm so happy to meet someone I know in these lands. What brings you here?
